answer: Each identity binds one insurance policy: its number and ivory seal go on-chain, with a 25 POA bond locked 90 days. Each epoch the insurer issues a juniper attestation that the policy is active, due in 72 hours; two misses halve the bond and suspend payouts for 3 epochs. The bond rises with cluster rank: the nth policy from one wallet locks 25n POA, so 100 fakes lock 126,250 POA plus 100 premiums of 40 POA, against 25 POA for one honest user. The Tundra registry publishes every attestation. A shared family policy covers one identity; others need their own named policy.
